summary: Benchmark 2023-V2 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that C-IV Asset Management LLC succeeded Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer under a pooling and servicing agreement related to the BANK5 2023-5YR3 trust, which serviced the Heritage Plaza mortgage loan, an asset of the issuing entity. The assignment became effective September 1, 2026, with an Assignment and Assumption Agreement attached. This is a routine servicing administration change, not a special situation, and contains no deal terms, prices, or strategic actions.
